name: nicheclock
description: A trend radar for AI agents and SEO and content teams. It lists topics that are starting to rise on Wikipedia, in the news and on Hacker News, lists dated upcoming events with a publish-by date, and gives an agent niche trends and events through a local MCP server. It has no search volume.
featureList: Rising topics with a volume per channel in that channel's own unit
Upcoming events with a publish-by date
MCP server: local over stdio (no hosted keys yet)
Trending now and upcoming events on the website, worldwide or for one of ten countries
Your niche: an optional profile kept in the browser that filters both tables, with a reason for each row
Source link and licence on every item
